A school just over the Surrey border remains closed following a gas leak.
Calthorpe Park School in Fleet was evacuated due to the incident on Thursday (January 8). Pupils were sent home or taken to a nearby leisure center, where parents were told to come and collect them.
The leak means that the school has had to remain closed for Friday (January 9) and details of what will happen next week are still up in the air.
